info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Melilite Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Melilite Jacket Detail Catalog API facilitates the addition of detailed information about Melilite jackets into the catalog system. This API allows retailers and product managers to enrich product offerings by submitting various attributes and specifications of the jackets, ensuring clear communication of product details to consumers. Typical users include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that aim to enhance their product listings. Through this API, organizations can streamline their catalog management processes and improve the overall shopping experience for customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create new details for a Melilite Jacket. It accepts the required properties in the request body, ensuring that all necessary information is provided to successfully add the new details to the catalog.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for creating or updating a melilite jacket entry. Ensure that all required fields are included for successful processing.

200.description: The request has been successfully completed, and the details have been retrieved.

melilite_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the melilite jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the melilite jacket.

quantity.description: The number of melilite jackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single melilite jacket.

CreateCatalogMeliliteJacketDetailRequest.description: Request body for creating a new melilite jacket order with details such as ID, requester, quantity, priority status, and unit price.
